dct_title_s: The Rand-McNally war map of Mexico : showing the war strength of the United States Army and Navy and of the Mexican Army and Navy also the location of the forts along the border line between the United States and Mexico.
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by hachures.; Information on the military situation has been added in red to the base map "The Rand-McNally new commercial atlas map of Mexico" (c1914).; Cover title.; Title above border: "The Mexican situation."; Prime meridian: Greenwich.; Indexed to principal cities.; Inset: State of Mexico and surrounding country (enlarged scale), c1910.; Text on Mexican events, 1913-1914, with war figures and statistics on the United States Army and Navy, and on the Mexican Army and Navy, as well as a map of North America from "The Rand-McNally new commercial atlas," c1912, on verso.
1 map : col. 47 x 65 cm., folded to 17 x 11 cm
